# Nabaraj Acharya / TechNabu

> Nabaraj Acharya is a Full Stack Developer and SEO Specialist based in Lalitpur, Nepal, trading as TechNabu. He builds Laravel web applications and provides technical SEO services for businesses in Nepal and abroad, with 3+ years of experience and 30+ completed projects.

TechNabu serves clients across Nepal (Kathmandu, Lalitpur, Khotang) and internationally, including Australia. Core technologies: Laravel, PHP, MySQL, Tailwind CSS, Alpine.js. SEO focus: technical SEO, on-page optimization, local SEO, Google Search Console, Google Analytics 4.
